title: Unit 9
topic: Travelling, Clothes, Words and phrases 9A, Words and phrases 9B

words.definition: to buy or reserve tickets before a trip
words.example: I usually book tickets online.

words.definition: to put clothes and things in a suitcase
words.example: She's packing a suitcase for her holiday.

words.definition: to go out of your home
words.example: I leave the house at 7.30 every day.
words.example_ru: Я выхожу из дома в 7:30 каждый день.

words.definition: to hold a suitcase and take it with you
words.example: He's carrying a heavy suitcase.

words.definition: to have dark glasses on your eyes
words.example: I always wear sunglasses in summer.
words.example_ru: Летом я всегда ношу солнечные очки.

words.definition: to take a taxi to go somewhere
words.example: It's late. Let's get a taxi home.
words.example_ru: Уже поздно. Давай возьмём такси до дома.

words.definition: to stay at the airport until your plane leaves
words.example: We're waiting for a flight to Rome.

words.definition: to pay money to use a car for a short time
words.example: We want to rent a car in Spain.
words.example_ru: Мы хотим арендовать машину в Испании.

words.definition: to get to a hotel
words.example: We arrive at a hotel late at night.
words.example_ru: Мы приезжаем в отель поздно вечером.

words.definition: to sleep in a hotel for some nights
words.example: We stay in a hotel near the beach.
words.example_ru: Мы живём в отеле у пляжа.

words.definition: to call your family
words.example: I phone home every Sunday.

words.definition: to buy things to give to people
words.example: I always buy presents for my family.

words.definition: short trousers
words.example: In summer I wear shorts.

words.definition: a jacket and trousers or skirt of the same material
words.example: He wears a suit to the office.
words.example_ru: В офис он ходит в костюме.

words.definition: a piece of clothing for women, top and skirt together
words.example: She's wearing a red dress.

words.definition: a long warm piece of clothing you wear outside
words.example: Take your coat. It's cold.

words.definition: things you wear on your feet in your shoes
words.example: Where are my black socks?

words.definition: sports shoes
words.example: I wear trainers to the gym.
words.example_ru: В спортзал я хожу в кроссовках.

words.definition: something you wear on your head
words.example: My grandfather always wears a hat.

words.definition: a soft hat with a hard part at the front
words.example: He's wearing a baseball cap.

words.definition: the place where you buy tickets for a show
words.example: You can buy tickets at the box office.

words.definition: a loud sound
words.example: What's that noise?

words.definition: a word you use for someone you love
words.example: Goodnight, darling.

words.definition: thirty minutes
words.example: The film starts in half an hour.

words.definition: not in a building
words.example: The children are playing outside.

words.definition: a question to check if someone is certain
words.example: The shop is closed. — Are you sure?

words.definition: a friendly thing to say when someone leaves
words.example: Bye, Anna. Have a good day.

words.definition: you say this when you meet someone soon
words.example: I'm on the bus. See you in 20 minutes.
words.example_ru: Я в автобусе. Увидимся через 20 минут.

words.definition: the person who is in charge of you at work
words.example: My boss is very nice.

words.definition: time spent working to learn about a job
words.example: Students do two weeks of work experience.

words.definition: to clean plates, cups, etc.
words.example: I cook and my husband washes the dishes.
words.example_ru: Я готовлю, а муж моет посуду.

words.definition: to make something that is broken work again
words.example: Can you repair something like this old radio?
words.example_ru: Ты можешь починить что-то вроде этого старого радио?

words.definition: to give breakfast to guests
words.example: The hotel serves breakfast from 7 to 10.

words.definition: to work a lot and very well
words.example: Nurses work hard every day.

words.definition: to make a room tidy and not dirty
words.example: It takes me an hour to clean a room.
words.example_ru: Мне нужен час, чтобы убрать комнату.

words.definition: to do things differently
words.example: The new boss wants to make changes.

words.definition: to meet people and become friends
words.example: It's easy to make friends at university.

words.definition: not working because it is damaged
words.example: My phone is broken.
